latest_release.body:
This release moves Maxun to PostgreSQL 18, a new MinIO image, and Node.js 26, and fixes two security issues.

**If you self-host Maxun, read the upgrade notes before upgrading:** your database is not migrated automatically.

## ⚠️ Before You Upgrade

- **PostgreSQL 13 → 18:** PostgreSQL 18 starts on a new, empty volume (`postgres18_data`). Move your data using a dump and restore first, or Maxun will start with an empty database. Your old volume is left untouched.
- **No going back without a backup:** On first start, the new backend upgrades its job queue tables. An older backend will then refuse to start against that database. Keep a backup until you're sure you're staying on v0.1.1.
- **Upgrade all images together:** Pull `maxun-backend`, `maxun-frontend`, and `maxun-browser` at the same time.
- **Local setups need Node.js 22.18 or later:** Node.js 18 and 20 are no longer supported.

👉 **Step-by-step guide:** [Upgrading to v0.1.1](https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/blob/main/docs/UPGRADING.md)

## Security

- **Browser service control endpoint secured:** The browser service no longer exposes its control endpoint publicly. Previously, anyone who could reach the browser service's ports could take control of the browser, including reading files it could access. The control endpoint is now only accessible to callers with `BROWSER_SERVICE_TOKEN`, and Docker Compose publishes browser ports on `127.0.0.1` only. 
- **Robots blocked from accessing internal addresses:** Robot URLs, the recorder's address bar, SDK scrape/crawl/extract requests, and anything a loaded page requests are now blocked from loopback, private networks, and cloud metadata addresses. Set `ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAVIGATION_URLS=true` only if you scrape intranet sites and trust every user of your instance. 
- **Node.js 26 in all Docker images:** Includes the fix for CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder RCE) and is supported until April 2029. 

## Self-hosting Changes

| Component | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL | `postgres:13` | `postgres:18`, new volume `postgres18_data` |
| MinIO | `minio/minio` (removed from Docker Hub) | `pgsty/silo`, a maintained MinIO fork. Same volume and settings, nothing to do |
| Node.js in images | 22 | 26.13.1 |
| Browser service ports | All interfaces | `127.0.0.1` only  |

### New Environment Variables

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `BROWSER_SERVICE_TOKEN` (recommended) | Shared secret between the backend and browser service. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. |
| `ALLOW_PRIVATE_NAVIGATION_URLS` (default: `false`) | Allows robots to open internal addresses. |
| `BROWSER_LISTEN_HOST` (default: `0.0.0.0`) | The interface the browser service listens on. |

## What's Changed
* chore: cleanup dead code by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1267
* feat: -rm border from recorder action buttons by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1270
* fix: better row limit text fit in recorder by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1272
* chore: Configure Renovate by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1271
* fix(i18n): add missing Azerbaijani strings by @jamalkamaladdin in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1282
* fix(output): summarize pages before filtering requested formats by @shuaiyafei in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1290
* fix(security): block SSRF to internal addresses from the server-side browser by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1298
* fix: !expose the browser service's Playwright endpoint by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1287
* feat: add overlay check for clickable buttons by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1289
* feat(maxun-core): only dismiss close buttons that sit inside a pop-up layer by @amhsirak in https://github.com/getmaxun/maxun/pull/1288
* fix(markdown): preserve encoded redirect destination queries by @shuaiyafei in https://gi

Byteful is a UK-based web data infrastructure platform providing ethically sourced residential, mobile, static residential (ISP) and datacenter proxies alongside API-first tools for web scraping, data collection, and AI-driven automation, processing tens of billions of requests per month. Discount: MAXUN10 - Get 10% off Byteful Residential Proxies.
Mango Proxy offers Residential, ISP, Datacenter, and Mobile Proxies in 200+ countries with HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 support and flexible IP management. Discount: MAXUN - 8% off Static ISP Proxies.
Nodemaven offers the most efficient proxy provider for Web Scraping and Automation with the Highest Quality IP on the market. Why Nodemaven? · ZIP targeting · 99.9% uptime · IP filtering: all proxies have fraud score <97% · No KYC required · Unique free tools: Proxy Bandwidth Checker, Meta Tag Checker, IP Lookup and others! Discounts: MAXUN2X — 2X traffic for Black Friday · MAXUN35 — 35% off Mobile & Residential · MAXUN40 - 40% off ISP (Static)
TestMu AI is the native AI-agentic cloud platform for quality engineering. Test intelligently and ship faster.
## What Maxun Does - **[Extract](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/extract)** – Extract structured data from any website by emulating real user behavior. * **[Recorder Mode](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/robot-actions)** – Record browser actions and turn them into reusable extraction robots. * **[AI Mode](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/llm-extraction)** – Describe what you need in natural language and extract it with AI. - **[Scrape](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/scrape/scrape-robots)** – Convert full webpages into Markdown, HTML and capture screenshots. - **[Crawl](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/crawl/crawl-introduction)** – Crawl entire websites and extract content across pages. - **[Agent](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/agent)** – Extract data from websites with AI that autonomously discovers where the data lives. - **[Search](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/search/search-introduction)** – Search the web and extract results with time-based filters. - **[Monitoring](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/monitoring)** – Track websites over time, detect changes, and get notified when they occur. - **[Document Extraction & Parsing](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/document)** – Extract and parse structured data from documents. ## How To Use Maxun - **[Dashboard](https://app.maxun.dev/login)** – Build, run, and manage robots through Maxun's visual interface. - **[API](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/api-reference)** – Integrate Maxun's scraping and extraction capabilities into your applications. - **[SDK](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/sdk)** – Use Maxun programmatically for scraping, extraction, automation and more. - **[CLI](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/cli)** – Create robots, trigger runs, and retrieve data from your terminal. - **[MCP](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/mcp)** – Connect Maxun to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol. ## Quick Start ### Getting Started The simplest & fastest way to get started is to use the hosted version: https://app.maxun.dev. ### Installation Maxun can run locally with or without Docker 1. [Setup with Docker Compose](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/docker) 2. [Setup without Docker](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/local) 3. [Environment Variables](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/environment_variables) 4. [SDK](https://github.com/getmaxun/node-sdk) ### Upgrading & Self Hosting 1. [Self Host Maxun With Docker](https://docs.maxun.dev/self-host) 2. [Upgrade Maxun With Docker Compose Setup](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-docker-compose) 3. [Upgrade Maxun Without Docker Compose Setup](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-local-setup) ## License

## Project Values We believe in fair and responsible use of open source. If you rely on this project commercially, please consider contributing back or supporting its development. ## Support Us Star the repository, contribute to the codebase, or [sponsor us](https://github.com/sponsors/amhsirak). ## Contributors Thank you to the combined efforts of everyone who contributes!

## Maxun 能做什么 - **[数据提取](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/extract)** – 通过模拟真实用户行为，从任何网站提取结构化数据。 * **[录制模式](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/robot-actions)** – 录制浏览器操作，并将其转化为可复用的提取机器人。 * **[AI 模式](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/extract/llm-extraction)** – 用自然语言描述你的需求，通过 AI 完成提取。 - **[网页抓取](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/scrape/scrape-robots)** – 将完整网页转换为 Markdown、HTML 并捕获截图。 - **[爬取](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/crawl/crawl-introduction)** – 爬取整个网站，跨页面提取内容。 - **[搜索](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/search/search-introduction)** – 搜索网页，并按时间筛选提取结果。 - **[监控](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/monitoring)** – 持续跟踪网站变化，并在变化发生时收到通知。 - **[文档提取与解析](https://docs.maxun.dev/robot/document)** – 从文档中提取并解析结构化数据。 ## 如何使用 Maxun - **[仪表盘](https://app.maxun.dev/login)** – 通过 Maxun 的可视化界面构建、运行和管理机器人。 - **[API](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/api-reference)** – 将 Maxun 的抓取和提取能力集成到你的应用中。 - **[SDK](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/sdk)** – 以编程方式使用 Maxun 进行抓取、提取、自动化等操作。 - **[CLI](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/cli)** – 在终端中创建机器人、触发运行并获取数据。 - **[MCP](https://docs.maxun.dev/category/mcp)** – 通过 Model Context Protocol 将 Maxun 连接到 AI 智能体。 ## 快速开始 ### 入门 最简单的快速上手方式是使用托管版本：https://app.maxun.dev。 ### 安装 无论是否使用 Docker，Maxun 都可以在本地运行 1. [使用 Docker Compose 搭建](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/docker) 2. [不使用 Docker 搭建](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/local) 3. [环境变量](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/environment_variables) 4. [SDK](https://github.com/getmaxun/node-sdk) ### 升级与自托管 1. [使用 Docker 自托管 Maxun](https://docs.maxun.dev/self-host) 2. [升级 Docker Compose 方式搭建的 Maxun](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-docker-compose) 3. [升级非 Docker Compose 方式搭建的 Maxun](https://docs.maxun.dev/installation/upgrade#upgrading-with-local-setup) ## 许可证

本项目基于 AGPLv3 许可证发布。

## 项目价值观 我们相信应当公平、负责任地使用开源。如果你在商业上依赖本项目，请考虑为项目做贡献或支持其开发。 ## 支持我们 给仓库点星、参与代码贡献，或者[赞助我们](https://github.com/sponsors/amhsirak)。 ## 贡献者 感谢每一位贡献者的共同努力！
